mechanism: Nicotine increases sympathomimetic activity and may counteract the antihypertensive and diuretic effects of bumetanide while increasing cardiovascular stress; bumetanide-induced hypokalemia may be potentiated by nicotine's effects on electrolyte metabolism.
action: Monitor blood pressure, potassium levels, and renal function regularly; counsel patients on smoking cessation; adjust diuretic dosing if needed based on clinical response.
